fufu 0.19.2 is a patch release. [`ff worktree`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/worktree/) given a remote's branch, tag, or commit now starts the new worktree there, commit hooks find the repository from any directory, and dependencies move past several RustSec advisories.

## Worktrees from a remote's branch or a revision

Given a remote's branch, `ff worktree` creates a local branch of the same name tracking it, or a branch named after the directory forked from it when that name is taken. A tag or commit starts a branch named after the directory at that revision. JSON carries `added.tracking` and `added.forked_from`. See the [worktrees guide](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/guides/worktrees/).

## Commit hooks

Hooks run with absolute `GIT_DIR` and `GIT_WORK_TREE` for every verb that runs them, so a hook that changes directory, as lefthook does for a job with `root:`, keeps the repository. [`ff commit`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/commit/) run from a subdirectory finds hooks under `.git/hooks`, runs `core.hooksPath` hooks against the right worktree, and hands `prepare-commit-msg` and `commit-msg` a message path that resolves.

## Dependencies

rustls moves to 0.23.46 for RUSTSEC-2026-0285, -0346, -0348, and -0349. It carries native HTTPS fetches and [`ff update`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/update/). faster-hex moves to 0.10.1 for RUSTSEC-2026-0306.
